newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Vincam arranges risk transfer deal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Vincam arranges risk transfer deal.

text.p: Vincam Group Inc said on Tuesday that it has agreed with Reliance National Insurance Co to provide workers' compensation insurance coverage that would help Vincam's fourth quarter results.

"We view this agreement with Reliance as a financing opportunity and not an operational decision, allowing us to fix our costs for the next three years," the company said in a statement about the risk transfer to Reliance.

Vincam said the agreement will eliminate any adverse earnings exposure through a fixed cost program from current and prior years' workers' compensation claims, removing that element of uncertainty from our operating results.
The program with Reliance, a unit of Payco American Corp, covers existing large deductible workers' compenstaion insurance policy for the years 1994, 1995 and 1996.
Effectively, the agreement is structured to allow the company to benefit from a better-than-expected loss experience without a corresponding downside risk.
Additionally, Reliance National Insurance Co has agreed to recommend Vincam's Workers' Compensation Managed Care Arrangement to its client base for the provision of managed care services.
